_note: HS6 FALLBACK config for the ~45 countries that have NO NTL data (they failed the NTL run with FILTER_DRIFT because Trade Map drops/falls-back the NTL detail for them). Detail=HS6 (6-digit, which nearly every country reports) instead of NTL. It has its OWN input list (input/countries-no-ntl.xlsx, the 45 no-NTL countries) and its OWN manifest (latest-run-hs6-fallback.json), so it is fully INDEPENDENT: it never touches the 143 finished NTL files or the big-country NTL retry, and the order you run things in does not matter. Run: npm run batch -- --config config/config.production-hs6-fallback.json  (resume-safe; re-run to continue). Files are named with HS6-Quantities so they never collide with the NTL files. Everything else (quantities, currency=na, speed, throttle, retries) matches the NTL config.
